external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A franchise colleague whose own identity provider vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system from which colleague and group membership changes come overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The franchise colleagues' own identity provider that vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, and supplies the public signing key to applications.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that authorizes holders of store-manager tokens to change prices and void transactions.
processes.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker for tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what that log records, whether it covers the franchise route, or whether the directory or the log are encrypted where they sit.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
data_flows.data_description: Colleague sign-in information.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague signs in through the identity broker using a vouch from its own identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.data_description: Franchise colleague sign-in information.

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: A vouch for a franchise colleague's sign-in.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a signed-in colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff id and group list.

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token to the store admin console and performs permitted price or transaction actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: A token and store administration actions involving prices and transactions.

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague presents a token to the store admin console and performs permitted price or transaction actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: A token and store administration actions involving prices and transactions.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: The public half of the token-signing key.

data_flows.name: use signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker uses the signing key kept in the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.data_description: The token-signing key.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleague and group membership information in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.data_description: Colleagues and their group memberships.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls colleague and group membership changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.data_description: Overnight colleague and group membership changes.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: It is unknown what the log records and whether it covers the franchise route.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in events.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise identity provider
trust_boundaries.description: The trust zone controlled by the franchise colleagues' own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

assumptions.assumption: The key store contains confidential data because it holds a signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds the broker's signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory contains confidential data because it holds colleague identities and group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log contains confidential data because it holds sign-in records that relate to colleagues.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
